title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Science - Physics - Laws of Motion
subject: General Science

questions.q: Newton’s First Law of Motion is also called the law of:
questions.explain: Newton's First Law states that an object continues in its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by a net external force. This property of an object to resist changes in its state of motion is called inertia.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: To prove the relationship between inertia and mass, a student compares the difficulty of kicking a football and kicking a stone of the same size. Which basic principle justifies the greater difficulty and potential injury associated with kicking the stone?
options: The stone has more mass, resulting in greater inertia, meaning it offers a greater resistance to changing its state of rest.
The stone is subjected to the first law of motion, while the football is governed by the second law.
The force applied on the stone is not sufficient to overcome the centripetal force holding its atoms together.
The stone has lower surface friction, due to which all applied forces dissipate.
questions.explain: Inertia is directly proportional to mass. Because the stone has a significantly higher mass than a football of the same size, it has greater inertia, thereby exerting a larger resistive force against the kick, which can cause injury.
